- Singapore, id1204683638 (FINAL FANTASY AWAKENING, Efun), captures 2019-04-08 and 2019-04-06: English, Simplified Chinese -- https://web.archive.org/web/20190408082437/https://itunes.apple.com/sg/app/final-fantasy-awakening/id1204683638?mt=8

- Combined: EN, ID, ZH-CN, ZH-TW from the listings
- Not read: the OASIS English release id1327210765 (its Wayback captures are 404 or 301, no page shown); a separate OASIS app "Final Fantasy Awakening PT/ES" id1377048813 (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/final-fantasy-awakening-pt-es/id1377048813, all three captures 404, 2024-07 to 2025-10), which suggests Portuguese and Spanish editions; the South Korean release (FL Studio Mobile, 2017-10-17) has no listing found

en.wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Final_Fantasy_Awakening#Release, text read by me via the API 2026-10-21), the user's grounds for the languages the listings do not show:
- English: "The game's English servers were shut down on October 31, 2019, by Oasis Games" (so an English release; the listings above also list English)
- Japanese (`JA`, native and voiced): "At the 2015 AWS Summit Tokyo, an open beta for Japan was announced for June, with releases following in Japan, North America and Europe"; the Play description says the original Japanese voice cast is in the game, and the Final Fantasy Wiki's Voice section (https://breezewiki.com/finalfantasy/wiki/Final_Fantasy_Awakening#Voice, pasted by user) says "The main characters are voiced in Japanese ... The Japanese voice cast from Final Fantasy Type-0 is maintained", which confirms Japanese (so no Japanese store listing is needed); but the page also says "Any Japanese release was being delayed until the game had a stable presence in the worldwide market", so a Japanese-language release is not shown
- Chinese: "releasing under that name first in China" and "in these regions [Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau], the game was given a title in traditional Chinese rather than English" (`ZH-CN`, `ZH-TW`; both appear in the listings)
- Korean (`KO`): "A South Korean release came through FL Studio Mobile on October 17" (2017); no store listing read (see the Korea section below), so `KO` is inferred from the release and from the game having an official Korean-language site
- Regions that hint at languages: Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau (Traditional Chinese), Indonesia (English and Indonesian, confirmed), Singapore and Malaysia (English and Simplified Chinese, confirmed), South Korea

## ja.wikipedia.org (Information; found by me 2026-10-21)

- Awakening has no page of its own on ja.wikipedia (no interlanguage link from en.wikipedia); it is covered in the entry for Agito / Type-0 Online in https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/ファイナルファンタジーシリーズの作品一覧 (read by me through the MediaWiki API)
  - "2016年に中国版、2018年に英語版[[:en:Final Fantasy Awakening]]がリリースされたが、いずれも2020年にサービス終了。当初の予定と異なり、日本版が提供されることはなかった。新規ゲームとして作られたというよりは完美世界の改変版に当たる。" (a China version in 2016 and an English version in 2018 were released, both closed in 2020; unlike the first plan, a Japanese version was never provided; it is less a new game than a modified version of Perfect World)
  - Consistent with en.wikipedia's "any Japanese release was being delayed": there was never a Japanese-language release, so `JA` on the entry rests on the Japanese voice cast (voiced), not on a Japanese version; the 2018 English date and the 2020 closing differ from our evidence (the OASIS Play page went 404 on 2019-10-05; en.wikipedia says the English servers closed 2019-10-31)
